---
title: "Last Christmas at Emmie and Jonas"
format:
  pjk_theme-html:
    toc: false
    navbar: false
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script data-goatcounter="https://pjkreutzer.goatcounter.com/count"
          async src="//gc.zgo.at/count.js"></script>
          <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ctext y='.9em' font-size='90'%3E❄️%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
          <style>
            @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Mountains+of+Christmas:wght@400;700&family=Josefin+Sans:wght@300;400&display=swap');

            body {
              background-color: #B3202A;
              margin: 0;
              padding: 0;
              min-height: 100vh;
            }

            #quarto-content {
              background-color: #B3202A;
            }

            .invite-wrapper {
              background-color: #B3202A;
              max-width: 550px;
              margin: 0 auto;
              padding: 2rem 1.5rem 3rem;
              position: relative;
              min-height: 90vh;
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
            }

            /* Top title: */
            .top-title {
              font-family: 'Mountains of Christmas', 'Josefin Sans', serif;
              font-weight: 700;
              font-size: clamp(2rem, 11vw, 5.5rem);
              line-height: 0.95;
              color: #FFF8E7;
              text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #7A1219;
              margin: 0;
              padding: 0;
              text-align: center;
              z-index: 2;
              position: relative;
              display: block;
            }

            .top-title .line1 {
              white-space: nowrap;
              font-size: clamp(2rem, 11vw, 5.5rem);
            }

            /* Photo container */
            .photo-container {
              position: relative;
              margin-top: -1rem;
              z-index: 1;
              width: 100%;
            }

            .photo-container img {
              width: 100%;
              height: auto;
              display: block;
            }

            /* Bottom text: */
            .bottom-title {
              font-family: 'Mountains of Christmas', 'Josefin Sans', serif;
              font-weight: 700;
              font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 9vw, 4.2rem);
              line-height: 0.95;
              color: #F6D56B;
              text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #7A1219;
              text-align: center;
              display: block;
              position: relative;
              margin-top: -0.5rem;
              z-index: 2;
              padding: 0;
            }

            /* Event details */
            .event-details {
              margin-top: 1.5rem;
              z-index: 2;
              position: relative;
            }

            .event-details .detail-line {
              font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif;
              font-weight: 400;
              font-size: 1rem;
              letter-spacing: 0.06em;
              text-transform: uppercase;
              color: #FFF8E7;
              line-height: 1.6;
            }

            .event-details .detail-line a {
              color: #F6D56B;
            }

            @media (max-width: 600px) {
              .top-title {
                margin-top: 30px;
              }
              .bottom-title {
                font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 7vw, 3rem);
                margin-top: -0.25rem;
              }
            }

            /* Falling snow */
            .snow-container {
              position: fixed;
              top: 0;
              left: 0;
              width: 100%;
              height: 100%;
              pointer-events: none;
              z-index: 9999;
              overflow: hidden;
            }

            .snowflake {
              position: absolute;
              top: 0;
              opacity: 0;
              animation: snowfall linear infinite;
            }

            @keyframes snowfall {
              0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, -10vh, 0) rotate(0deg); }
              8%   { opacity: 0.9; }
              92%  { opacity: 0.9; }
              100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(var(--drift), 110vh, 0) rotate(180deg); }
            }

            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              .snowflake { animation: none; opacity: 0; }
            }

            /* Hide default quarto elements */
            #title-block-header { display: none; }
            .page-columns { padding: 0; }
            main.content { padding: 0; margin: 0; }
          </style>
---
